profile.org_note: Family-owned and founder-run. Mori Hosseini (chairman, CEO, owner) sits over a small corporate team in Daytona Beach; Tom McCall (COO, also listed as CFO) runs operations and finance; three division offices (Mid-Florida, North Florida, West Florida) are led by division managers. Land is decided at the top: Hosseini is the principal on land deals and partnerships, a vice president for land development (Dick Smith) handles entitlements, and land is typically held in special-purpose ICI subsidiaries.
profile.summary: Private, family-owned Florida semi-custom builder (2026 Builder 100 rank 92; about 590 closings on about $607M, so roughly $1M a home) with around 270 staff and 16,000+ homes built since 1980. It builds in master-planned communities around Daytona Beach, Jacksonville, Orlando, Tampa, Sarasota, Gainesville and now Ocala. It is a land developer as well as a builder: it develops its own communities in its home market (Plantation Bay, Mosaic) and co-develops Seven Pines in Jacksonville with David Weekley Homes, while buying finished lots from third-party master developers elsewhere. A 2025 trade feature says it plans to expand south and on the Gulf coast through more land acquisition.

people.name: Dick Smith
people.title: Vice President for Land Development

The only land executive named in any 2025-2026 source found. Reporting line inferred: founder-run company where the chairman directs land.

Neither article gives a title, and no 2025-2026 source was found, so he may have left or changed role. Title note: Title not stated.

people.name: Tom McCall
people.title: Chief Operating Officer
people.prior_role: About 18 years with public homebuilders; earlier a national accounting firm; CPA
people.source_title: Halifax Health Board of Commissioners bio: Tom McCall
people.note: Finance decision-maker as far as public sources show. His hospital-board bio (undated, live in 2026) lists both CFO and COO and gives him financial reporting, budgeting, cash flow and financial controls. ICI's own 2025-2026 press releases (latest Oct 20, 2026) and the Jacksonville Daily Record (Jan 2026) call him only Chief Operating Officer, so the CFO title could be out of date; no separate CFO is named anywhere public. About 16 years at ICI as of early 2025. He announces division and VP appointments, so division managers appear to report to him. Title note: Halifax Health board bio: Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operating Officer.

people.name: Mori Hosseini
people.title: Chairman & CEO (founder and owner)
people.source_title: ICI Homes: About ICI Homes (leadership section)
people.note: Founded the company in 1980 as Intervest Construction, Inc. The company page also lists him as chairman of the affiliated Allstar Building Materials and Southern Title companies. Owns ICI with his wife Forough (2025 trade feature). He is named as managing partner of the Seven Pines land partnership with David Weekley Homes, so he is the principal on land deals.

people.title: Executive Vice President of Information Systems

people.note: Co-owner with Mori Hosseini per the feature; founder and chair of the FBH Community charity.

people.name: Joe Blanco
people.title: North Florida Division Manager

people.name: Greg Jones
people.title: Tampa Division Manager

gaps: Chief Financial Officer: no current primary source. Tom McCall is listed as CFO and COO on an undated hospital-board bio; 2025-2026 company releases call him only COO. No controller, treasurer or VP of finance is publicly named.
Head of land acquisition: not publicly disclosed. The last public name (John T. Laga, VP of land acquisition for central Florida) is from a 2014 search snippet only and was not used.

Mid-Florida / East Central (Daytona Beach) division manager: not confirmed. Last public name is Samuel Morrisett (Ormond Beach Observer, April 2018); no newer source found, so he is not listed as a person.
Orlando / Central Florida division leader: not publicly named; the Tampa division manager fronted the 2026 Orlando-area launch.

Don Wilford (North Florida division president since the mid-1990s) was last confirmed in July 2017 as division president and senior advisor; 2026 releases name Joe Blanco as North Florida division manager, so Wilford is not listed.
Ron Ferguson was named West Florida division manager in Jan 2018; Greg Jones has held the Tampa seat since at least Feb 2023, so Ferguson is not listed.
Hosseini family members in the business: a 2025 trade feature says the Hosseini children have joined the company, but no names or titles are published.
Direct phone numbers and emails for executives: not published (the company lists only general and sales lines and info@icihomes.com).
The company's leadership page names only Mori Hosseini; there is no published executive roster.
